higherTimeframeTrend: Use the exact A1 implementation definition: previous completed HTF EMA20/EMA50 direction, close vs EMA20, and five-HTF-bar EMA50 slope; never current incomplete HTF.

reference.events: Generic E1 candidates with setupClass=BREAKOUT only.
reference.baselineGeometry: Frozen E1 trigger_close + structure_plus_atr_noise + hybrid_structure_volatility_ladder + fixed_full_exit.
reference.goodOpportunityAudit: 2.0 ATR favorable barrier before 1.0 ATR adverse barrier; adverse wins same-bar ambiguity.

targetSelection.selection: Sort nearest-to-farthest. TP1 nearest candidate >=1.0R, TP2 next distinct candidate >=2.0R, TP3 next distinct candidate >=3.0R.
targetSelection.failure: No trade if three progressive candidates cannot be selected.

metrics.positiveMonth: UTC signal-month sum of net R > 0.
metrics.firstSecondHalf: Chronological entered-trade mean net R before/after midpoint.
metrics.concentration: max positive market-family total R / sum positive market-family total R.
metrics.bootstrapUtilityDelta: candidate-level C1 utility (net R or zero on abstain) minus frozen E1 baseline utility on the same reference event.

sameBarOrdering: failed-breakout close test after bar completes
forbidden: Any threshold or target candidate change after C1 results.
Any time-validation or holdout access on C1 failure.
